components.name: Search trigger
components.description: Desktop search entry with a shortcut hint.
components.css: .ds-search-trigger{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;width:244px;min-height:38px;padding:8px 11px;border:1px solid var(--line,#2c3337);border-radius:6px;background:var(--rail,#141719);color:var(--muted,#a5afb2);font:13px var(--body,'IBM Plex Sans',sans-serif);text-align:left;cursor:pointer}.ds-search-trigger kbd{margin-left:auto;border:1px solid var(--line,#2c3337);border-radius:4px;padding:1px 5px;font:11px var(--body,'IBM Plex Sans',sans-serif)}.ds-search-trigger:hover{border-color:var(--quiet,#929ea2);color:var(--ink,#eef0eb)}.ds-search-trigger:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--acid,#dfff00);outline-offset:5px}

components.name: Search input
components.description: Transparent field on the dark modal surface.
components.css: .ds-search-field{background:var(--rail,#141719);padding:16px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line,#2c3337)}.ds-search-field input{background:transparent;color:var(--ink,#eef0eb);border:0;min-width:0;width:100%;padding:4px;font:16px var(--body,'IBM Plex Sans',sans-serif);caret-color:var(--acid,#dfff00)}.ds-search-field input::placeholder{color:var(--quiet,#929ea2)}.ds-search-field input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--acid,#dfff00);outline-offset:5px}

components.name: Resource navigation
components.description: Muted guide links with acid active-page marker.
components.html: OverviewInstallAPI reference
components.css: .ds-nav{background:var(--rail,#141719);padding:12px}.ds-nav a{display:block;padding:7px 12px;border-left:1px solid transparent;color:var(--muted,#a5afb2);font:13px/1.5 var(--body,'IBM Plex Sans',sans-serif);text-decoration:none}.ds-nav a:hover{color:var(--ink,#eef0eb);background:var(--surface,#1a1e21)}.ds-nav a[aria-current]{color:var(--acid,#dfff00);border-left-color:var(--acid,#dfff00);background:#20251c}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--acid,#dfff00);outline-offset:5px}

components.name: Search result
components.description: Title, excerpt and cyan location in a compact actionable row.
components.html: InstallInstall and configure the resource for your server.lt-database / docs / INSTALL
components.css: .ds-result{display:block;background:var(--rail,#141719);padding:15px 17px;border-radius:5px;text-decoration:none;color:var(--ink,#eef0eb)}.ds-result strong{display:block;font:500 15px var(--display,'Space Grotesk',sans-serif);margin:0 0 6px}.ds-result span{display:block;color:var(--muted,#a5afb2);font:12px/1.6 var(--body,'IBM Plex Sans',sans-serif);overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-result .ds-path{font-size:10px;color:var(--cyan,#78d9df);margin-top:8px}.ds-result:hover,.ds-result:focus-visible{background:var(--surface-hover,#23292d)}.ds-result:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--acid,#dfff00);outline-offset:5px}

narrative.overview:
The shipped world is sleek cyberpunk: graphite surfaces, acid yellow wayfinding, cyan reading links, precise display type and calm long-form text. Its character comes from typography, thin divisions and the angular brand mark; the documentation stays readable and practical.

This system describes the custom MkDocs theme deployed on GitHub Pages. Source Markdown remains compatible with GitBook Git Sync; the theme does not style the GitBook account. The direction contract is recorded in `theme/main.html` (seed `a64120cb`).
keyCharacteristics: Dark tonal layers with restrained accent color.
Grouped resource navigation and spacious directory rows.
Technical content with clear reading links, code and source attribution.

rules.name: The Wayfinding Rule
rules.body: Preserve acid for navigation and interaction emphasis, and cyan for reading links.

dos: Do preserve the graphite, acid and cyan role separation.
Do keep long-form reading in IBM Plex Sans with contained code and table overflow.
Do preserve keyboard focus, modal behavior and reduced-motion states.
Do extend resource navigation without implying dependency on the panel.
donts: Don't replace directory rows with nested decorative cards.
Don't use the display font for long reading passages.
Don't imply that the custom GitHub Pages theme changes GitBook styling.
